Summary

COCRDSLC is an online CICS program that accepts and processes credit card detail requests, allowing users to search for and display credit card information by account number and card number. The program handles user input validation, retrieves card records from VSAM files, and presents the card details (including card name, expiration date, and status) on a screen. It is a main/driver program that manages navigation between the credit card list screen, the detail screen, and the main menu.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize working storage areas, communication areas, and set default return message to off at program start 2: Communication Area Loading - Load previously stored communication area data (account ID, card number, program context) from passed commarea if returning to this screen, or initialize fresh if coming from main menu 3: PF Key Mapping - Capture and store the function key pressed by the user (Enter or PF3) and validate it as an acceptable key for this screen 4: Invalid Key Handling - When an unsupported function key is pressed, default the action to Enter key behavior to continue normal screen processing 5: PF3 Exit Navigation - When user presses PF3, determine the calling program and transaction to return to (either the main menu or the originating program), update navigation context, and transfer control back 6: Direct Entry from Card List Screen - When arriving directly from the Credit Card List screen with pre-validated account and card number, skip input gathering and immediately retrieve card details for display 7: Initial Screen Display - When entering the screen fresh from another context (not re-entering), display the credit card detail search screen prompting the user for input without any pre-filled data 8: User Input Processing - When the user has re-entered the screen after providing input, receive and validate the entered account number and card number before attempting data retrieval 9: Screen Initialization - Set up screen header information including screen titles, transaction ID, program name, current date, and current time for display 10: Account ID Display Setup - Populate the account ID field on screen from the communication area; display low-values if account ID is zero, otherwise display the stored account number 11: Card Number Display Setup - Populate the card number field on screen from the communication area; display low-values if card number is zero, otherwise display the stored card number 12: Card Details Display - When card data has been successfully retrieved, populate the screen with card holder name, card expiration month, card expiration year, and card active status 13: Default Prompt Message - When no informational message is set, default the screen prompt to instruct the user to enter Account and Card Number 14: Error and Info Message Display - Move the return/error message and informational message to their respective screen output fields for user feedback 15: Screen Field Protection - When arriving from the Card List screen, protect (make read-only) the account ID and card number input fields; otherwise make them editable 16: Cursor Positioning - Position the cursor on the account ID field when account filter is invalid or blank, on the card number field when card filter is invalid or blank, defaulting to account ID field otherwise 17: Screen Field Color Setup - When coming from Card List screen, set account and card fields to default color; highlight account ID field in red if account filter is invalid; highlight card number field in red if card filter is invalid 18: Blank Field Red Highlight - When re-entering the screen and account or card number field was left blank, display an asterisk in the field and highlight it in red to indicate required input 19: Info Message Color - Display the informational message area in dark/dim color when no message exists, or neutral color when a message is present 20: Screen Transmission - Send the formatted credit card detail screen to the user terminal with cursor positioning and keyboard unlocked, marking program state as re-enter for next interaction 21: User Input Reception - Receive the data entered by the user from the credit card detail search screen into the input map area 22: Input Field Normalization - Replace asterisk or space values in account ID and card number input fields with low-values to standardize blank/cleared field detection 23: Account Number Validation - Validate that the account number is provided (not blank/zero) and is numeric; set appropriate error flags and messages if account number is missing or non-numeric, and store valid account number in communication area 24: Card Number Validation - Validate that the card number is provided (not blank/zero) and is numeric; set appropriate error flags and messages if card number is missing or non-numeric, and store valid card number in communication area 25: Cross-Field Validation - Check that at least one search criterion (account number or card number) has been provided; if both are blank, set a 'no search criteria received' error message 26: Card Record Retrieval by Card Number - Read the card data file using the card number as the key to retrieve the full card record including card holder name, expiration date, and active status 27: Card Not Found Handling - When the card record is not found for the given account and card number combination, set input error flags for both account and card filters and display appropriate 'not found' message to user 28: Successful Card Retrieval Confirmation - When card record is successfully read from the file, mark the result as 'found cards for account' to trigger display of card details on screen 29: Return with Context Preservation - Before returning to CICS, move the error message to the screen error field, package both the application commarea and program-specific commarea, and return with the current transaction ID for next interaction 30: Unexpected Scenario Handling - When an unrecognized program state is encountered, set an abend culprit, error code, and display an unexpected data scenario message to the user

Datasource Name Type Usage
CARDDAT CICS FILE (VSAM KSDS) Read credit card record by card number to retrieve card details including embossed name, expiration date, and active status
CARDAIX CICS FILE (VSAM Alternate Index) Read credit card record by account ID using an alternate index path (defined but not invoked in the main processing flow)

SCREEN VARIABLE SETUP (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS): - Populates Account Number field (ACCTSIDO) from CC-ACCT-ID - Populates Card Number field (CARDSIDO) from CC-CARD-NUM - When card data is found, populates: * CRDNAMEO ← CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME (Name on card) * EXPMONO ← CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH (Expiry month) * EXPYEARO ← CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR (Expiry year) * CRDSTCDO ← CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS (Card active status) - Populates message fields: * ERRMSGO ← WS-RETURN-MSG (Error message) * INFOMSGO ← WS-INFO-MSG (Information message) ```cobol 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS. IF EIBCALEN = 0 SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT TO TRUE ELSE IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID = 0 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO ACCTSIDO OF CCRDSLAO ELSE MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO ACCTSIDO OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CARDSIDO OF CCRDSLAO ELSE MOVE CC-CARD-NUM TO CARDSIDO OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT MOVE CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME TO CRDNAMEO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE TO CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE-X MOVE CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH TO EXPMONO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR TO EXPYEARO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS TO CRDSTCDO OF CCRDSLAO END-IF END-IF IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT TO TRUE END-IF MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE WS-INFO-MSG TO INFOMSGO OF CCRDSLAO ``` 3. SCREEN ATTRIBUTE SETUP (1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS): - Controls field protection based on calling program context: * If coming from Card List screen (COCRDLIC): protects ACCTSIDA and CARDSIDA (read-only) * Otherwise: sets ACCTSIDA and CARDSIDA to unprotected (editable) - Controls cursor positioning: * Positions cursor on ACCTSIDL if account filter is invalid or blank * Positions cursor on CARDSIDL if card filter is invalid or blank * Default: positions cursor on ACCTSIDL - Controls field colors: * Sets ACCTSIDC and CARDSIDC to default color if coming from Card List screen * Sets ACCTSIDC to red (DFHRED) if account filter is invalid * Sets CARDSIDC to red (DFHRED) if card filter is invalid * Displays '*' in ACCTSIDO with red color if account filter is blank on re-entry * Displays '*' in CARDSIDO with red color if card filter is blank on re-entry * Sets INFOMSGC to dark (DFHBMDAR) if no info message, neutral (DFHNEUTR) otherwise ```cobol 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS. IF CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET EQUAL LIT-CCLISTMAPSET AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-CCLISTPGM MOVE DFHBMPRF TO ACCTSIDA OF CCRDSLAI MOVE DFHBMPRF TO CARDSIDA OF CCRDSLAI ELSE MOVE DFHBMFSE TO ACCTSIDA OF CCRDSLAI MOVE DFHBMFSE TO CARDSIDA OF CCRDSLAI END-IF EVALUATE TRUE WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL OF CCRDSLAI WHEN FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK WHEN FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK MOVE -1 TO CARDSIDL OF CCRDSLAI WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL OF CCRDSLAI END-EVALUATE IF CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET EQUAL LIT-CCLISTMAPSET AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-CCLISTPGM MOVE DFHDFCOL TO ACCTSIDC OF CCRDSLAO MOVE DFHDFCOL TO CARDSIDC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK MOVE DFHRED TO CARDSIDC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER MOVE '*' TO ACCTSIDO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER MOVE '*' TO CARDSIDO OF CCRDSLAO MOVE DFHRED TO CARDSIDC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE MOVE DFHBMDAR TO INFOMSGC OF CCRDSLAO ELSE MOVE DFHNEUTR TO INFOMSGC OF CCRDSLAO END-IF ``` 4. SEND SCREEN (1400-SEND-SCREEN): - Sends the populated CCRDSLAO map to the terminal ```cobol 1400-SEND-SCREEN. MOVE LIT-THISMAPSET TO CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET MOVE LIT-THISMAP TO CCARD-NEXT-MAP SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE EXEC CICS SEND MAP(CCARD-NEXT-MAP) MAPSET(CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) FROM(CCRDSLAO) CURSOR ERASE FREEKB RESP(WS-RESP-CD) END-EXEC ``` 5. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP(LIT-THISMAP) MAPSET(LIT-THISMAPSET) INTO(CCRDSLAI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC ``` 6. EDIT MAP INPUTS (2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS): - Reads ACCTSIDI from CCRDSLAI and moves to CC-ACCT-ID (replaces '*' or spaces with LOW-VALUES) - Reads CARDSIDI from CCRDSLAI and moves to CC-CARD-NUM (replaces '*' or spaces with LOW-VALUES) ```cobol 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS. SET INPUT-OK TO TRUE SET FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE IF ACCTSIDI OF CCRDSLAI = '*' OR ACCTSIDI OF CCRDSLAI = SPACES MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CC-ACCT-ID ELSE MOVE ACCTSIDI OF CCRDSLAI TO CC-ACCT-ID END-IF IF CARDSIDI OF CCRDSLAI = '*' OR CARDSIDI OF CCRDSLAI = SPACES MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CC-CARD-NUM ELSE MOVE CARDSIDI OF CCRDSLAI TO CC-CARD-NUM END-IF PERFORM 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT THRU 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT PERFORM 2220-EDIT-CARD THRU 2220-EDIT-CARD-EXIT IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK SET NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED TO TRUE END-IF ``` 7. ACCOUNT FIELD VALIDATION (2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT): - Validates the account number entered in ACCTSIDI: * If blank/zeros: sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK, sets error message 'Account number not provided' * If not numeric: sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK, sets error message for non-numeric account * If valid: moves CC-ACCT-ID to CDEMO-ACCT-ID, sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID ```cobol 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT. SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL SPACES OR CC-ACCT-ID-N EQUAL ZEROS SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT TO TRUE END-IF MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT END-IF IF CC-ACCT-ID IS NOT NUMERIC SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF MOVE 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' TO WS-RETURN-MSG END-IF MOVE ZERO TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT ELSE MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE END-IF ``` 8. CARD FIELD VALIDATION (2220-EDIT-CARD): - Validates the card number entered in CARDSIDI: * If blank/zeros: sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK, sets error message 'Card number not provided' * If not numeric: sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK, sets error message for non-numeric card * If valid: moves CC-CARD-NUM-N to CDEMO-CARD-NUM, sets FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID ```cobol 2220-EDIT-CARD. SET FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF CC-CARD-NUM EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR CC-CARD-NUM EQUAL SPACES OR CC-CARD-NUM-N EQUAL ZEROS SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-CARD TO TRUE END-IF MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-CARD-NUM GO TO 2220-EDIT-CARD-EXIT END-IF IF CC-CARD-NUM IS NOT NUMERIC SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF MOVE 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' TO WS-RETURN-MSG END-IF MOVE ZERO TO CDEMO-CARD-NUM GO TO 2220-EDIT-CARD-EXIT ELSE MOVE CC-CARD-NUM-N TO CDEMO-CARD-NUM SET FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE END-IF ```
